Very good lift. At a lift of almost 1m it is stable enough that my wife and I can sleep in a tent on the roof of the trailer. I recommend it.

Actually more impressed with it than I had anticipated. Feels pretty heavy duty, the mounting plate is thick and looks pretty robust. I am using it on an older car trailer so I figure (hope) it serves very well. I figure keep it greased and it'll last well enough.
heavy duty low profile jack for my center console. combined with the drop leg this is perfect. 2022 Seapro 228.

Excellent. Pleasantly surprised by the apparent quality given the low price point. But it works very well.

Sehr schnelle Lieferung. Der Kettenzug funktioniert. Bin etwas enttäuscht, dass die Ketten nicht verzinkt sind, sondern geölte Stahlketten. Da wird man immer schmutzig. Am Artikelbild sieht man eine verzinkte Kette.
